answer: Each agent posts a slashable bond and a verifiable funding trail before mining. A Sybil factory must replicate that bond per persona, while per-seat rewards shrink as identities multiply. Like a settlement river, identical funding sources converge into one accountable account, so duplicates merge, not pay twice, and a saffron-marked ledger traces each stake to its payer. As a falcon strikes one target, precision beats numbers. An attacker minting N identities pays N bonds and forfeits all on the first duplicate, yet still splits rewards N ways, so cost scales while revenue stays flat.
